manifest.name: deepseek-computer-use
manifest.description: DSH 社区 Windows 桌面插件：窗口截图、界面控件、鼠标键盘、会话授权与操作审计。欢迎提交 issues 和 PR。

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:integration && node test/parity.mjs && node test/parity-js.mjs

manifest.author: STARDUSTLC666

bundle.text:
# deepseek-computer-use —— Windows 桌面控制（Computer Use）插件。
#
# 安装即向宿主注册 16 个工具：list_apps / list_windows / get_window / launch_app /
# get_window_state / click / press_key / type_text / scroll / set_value / drag /
# perform_secondary_action / activate_window / start_audio_recording /
# stop_audio_recording / computer_use_health。
#
# 首次加载会在 native/bin 下用系统自带 csc.exe 编译 helper（无需 .NET SDK、
# 无 npm 原生依赖）。全部配置项都有安全默认值，空配置即可启动：
#
#   - id: deepseek-computer-use
#     config:
#       approval: sensitive        # never | sensitive | always
#       allowApps: []              # 空 = 不限制；可用 exe 路径子串或进程名
#       denyApps: []
#       defaultIncludeScreenshot: true   # Codex parity: capture unless told otherwise
#       settleMs: 1000                   # wait for the UI to settle before the next capture
#       appConsent: session              # ask once per app (never = skip)
#       maxElements: 260
#       snapshotTtlMs: 120000
#       dryRun: false
#       toolPrefix: ''             # 例如 cu_ 可避免与其他插件的 click 重名
#       audio: false             # 开启 WASAPI 环回录音（start/stop_audio_recording）
#       redactApps: []           # 这些应用的截图永不出机器，例如 ["1password"]
- insert:
    - id: deepseek-computer-use
      name: 'deepseek-computer-use'
      config: {}

readme.text: **简体中文** · [English](README.en.md)

**让 DSH 在授权范围内操作 Windows 应用。**

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseek-computer-use) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseek-computer-use)
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseek-computer-use)

**[安装使用](#安装) · [使用流程](#开始使用) · [完整说明](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.zh.md)**

- 先查看窗口截图或界面控件，再决定下一步。
- 通过会话应用授权限制操作范围。
- 检查实际结果，保留操作审计与中断能力。

在 DSH 桌面版「插件」面板安装 `deepseek-computer-use`。已配置命令行时也可使用：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add deepseek-computer-use
```

网页版把 `desktop` 改为 `web`；安装后重启对应的 DSH。宿主要求以包声明 `>=0.2.1-rc.3` 为准。

1. 在 Windows 10/11 的实际 DSH profile 中安装 deepseek-computer-use，然后创建新会话。
2. 打开目标软件，并在对话中说明要操作的应用、目标和允许范围。
3. 按提示批准会话应用授权；先让助手查看窗口截图或界面控件，再执行点击和输入。
4. 敏感操作先核对审批内容；失败或结果不明确时重新观察，避免重复提交。
5. 检查软件中的实际结果；需要中断时取消当前任务，插件会停止本次原生助手。

可以这样说：

> 先查看目标应用的窗口和控件，说明下一步计划，暂不点击或输入。

面向 Windows 10/11；应用权限、控件支持和桌面环境会影响可操作范围。

配置、完整工具与排错见[详细使用说明](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.zh.md)。
在工作台或原生插件详情页底部检查更新。默认自动检查，**默认不自动安装**；是否安装、何时重启由你决定。Suite 管理的组件随整包更新。[查看更新规则](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.zh.md)。

- [详细使用、配置与边界](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.zh.md)
- [更新记录](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

如果插件帮到了你，欢迎 Star，让更多人发现它。问题和建议请提交 [Issues](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/issues)，也欢迎代码与文档 [PR](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/pulls)。反馈时附上版本与复现步骤，并移除凭据。

[简体中文](README.md) · **English**

**Let DSH work with Windows apps within your approval.**

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseek-computer-use) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseek-computer-use)

**[Install](#install) · [Workflow](#start-using-it) · [Full guide](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.en.md)**

- Inspect a screenshot or UI controls before the next step.
- Limit actions through session-level application approval.
- Check the result and keep audit and cancellation controls.

Open **Plugins** in the DSH desktop app and install `deepseek-computer-use`. If the CLI is available:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add deepseek-computer-use
```

For the web profile, replace `desktop` with `web`. Restart that DSH profile after installation. The package’s DSH requirement is `>=0.2.1-rc.3`.

1. Install deepseek-computer-use in your Windows 10/11 DSH profile, then start a new session.
2. Open the target application and describe the app, goal and allowed scope in the conversation.
3. Approve the session application access when prompted; inspect the window or controls before clicking and typing.
4. Review approval details for sensitive actions; re-observe after failures or uncertain results instead of submitting twice.
5. Check the result in the application. Cancel the task to stop its native helper when needed.

Example request：

> Inspect the target app window and controls, then explain the next step without clicking or typing.

For Windows 10/11. Permissions, control support and the desktop environment affect what can be automated.

Configuration, detailed tools and troubleshooting: [full reference](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.en.md).

Check updates at the bottom of the workbench or native plugin details. Automatic checks are on by default; **automatic installation is off**. You choose whether to install and when to restart. Suite-managed components update with their bundle. [Update behavior](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.en.md).

- [Full usage, configuration and limits](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.en.md)
- [Release notes](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

If the plugin helps, a Star makes it easier for others to discover. Report problems or suggest improvements in [Issues](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/issues); code and documentation [PRs](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use/pulls) are welcome. Include versions and reproduction steps, and remove credentials from reports.
